en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of an industrial complex beside a river or lake, surrounded by fields and forest. The site includes long factory halls, several tall silos, a central smokestack emitting smoke, smaller brick buildings, roads and parked vehicles. In the lower left corner there is a small printed logo with the text 'HAMMAR', suggesting the image is a printed postcard of this industrial locality.
